name: Deadly Dungeons
summary:
Unleash chaos in the depths: The Deadly Dungeons Bundle
With Ancient Dungeon and Deadly Delivery joining forces, this bundle lets you dodge traps to deliver packages as a frantic delivery goblin or slice through monstrosities as a legendary hero. 
This collaboration will also include two in-game cosmetic pieces that fuses these two worlds together:
- a hat with goblin ears in Ancient Dungeon
- a slime head piece in Deadly Delivery
Grab your sword (and your mailbag) and prepare to dive into chaotic procedura
